name: guide-recorder-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the guide-recorder spike: extension/ (capture), api/ (ingest+serve), web/ (viewer), shared/ (types).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @guide-recorder/extension && npm run build -w @guide-recorder/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @guide-recorder/shared && npm run typecheck -w @guide-recorder/extension && npm run typecheck -w @guide-recorder/api && npm run typecheck -w @guide-recorder/web
